fn CountOnesInBinary(n: Int) -> Int
  requires (n >= 1)
  ensures (result == (if (n == 1) then 1 else if ((n % 2) == 1) then (1 + CountOnesInBinary((n / 2))) else CountOnesInBinary((n / 2))))
  ensures (result >= 1)
  effects pure
  example (CountOnesInBinary(1) == 1)
  example (CountOnesInBinary(3) == 2)

}
